6 . When developing a nutritional plan of care, which factor should the nurse consider for improving client 
adherence to plan? 
a. Level of engagement 
b. Age 
c. Gender 
d. Comorbidities 
7 . Which assessment finding in a client on dialysis is of concern to the nurse? 
a. Client is not restricting protein intake. 
b. Client chooses foods that are low in potassium. 
c. Client drinks large amounts of fluids. 
d. Client has increased intake of calcium. 
8 . What instruction should the nurse give to a client on a fluid restriction secondary to kidney disease who 
reports increased thirst? 
a. Suck on hard, sweet candies. 
b. Use large glasses for drinking. 
c. Fill drinking glasses completely. 
d. Sip fluids slowly.
